name: 4-channel TCRT5000 IR line tracking module
description: Four-way reflective IR line tracker for robot cars: four Vishay TCRT5000 probe boards (950 nm IR LED plus phototransistor, best at about 2.5 mm, usable 0.2-15 mm) cabled to a control board whose LM339 quad comparator turns each probe signal into a digital output, with one sensitivity trimmer and one indicator LED per channel. Each output (IN1-IN4) is open collector with a 10 kOhm pull-up to VCC: LOW over a white / reflective surface (LED on), HIGH over a black line or nothing. Runs on 3.3-5 V; outputs swing to VCC. Sold as: 4-channel infrared tracing / line tracking module (red LM339 control board with 4 blue trimmers and LEDs D1-D5, 6-pin header VCC, GND, IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4, plus 4 TCRT5000 probe boards and Dupont cables), the common clone kit.
eli5: Four little eyes that look down at the floor and tell your board which of them is over a black line, so a robot car can steer to follow the track.

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Supply, 3.3-5 V (header pin 1). Also feeds the four TCRT5000 probes and the output pull-ups, so use 3V3 on an ESP32 or Pico.

pins.name: IN1
pins.description: Channel 1 digital output (header pin 3; the vendor datasheet calls it OUT1): LM339 open collector with a 10 kOhm pull-up (R1) to VCC. LOW over a white / reflective surface (LED D1 on), HIGH over a black line or with nothing in range.

pins.name: IN2
pins.description: Channel 2 digital output (header pin 4; the vendor datasheet calls it OUT2): LM339 open collector with a 10 kOhm pull-up (R2) to VCC. LOW over a white / reflective surface (LED D2 on), HIGH over a black line or with nothing in range.

pins.name: IN3
pins.description: Channel 3 digital output (header pin 5; the vendor datasheet calls it OUT3): LM339 open collector with a 10 kOhm pull-up (R3) to VCC. LOW over a white / reflective surface (LED D3 on), HIGH over a black line or with nothing in range.

pins.name: IN4
pins.description: Channel 4 digital output (header pin 6; the vendor datasheet calls it OUT4): LM339 open collector with a 10 kOhm pull-up (R4) to VCC. LOW over a white / reflective surface (LED D4 on), HIGH over a black line or with nothing in range.

supplierQuery: 4 channel TCRT5000 infrared line tracking sensor module LM339
buildNotes: Header to the microcontroller (right-angle, 6 pins) as printed: VCC, GND, IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4. The vendor datasheet numbers them 1-6 and calls the signals OUT1-OUT4; they are outputs despite the IN label.
The other edge carries four 3-pin probe connectors (VCC, GND, IN1 ... IN4): plug probe 1 into IN1 and so on, matching each probe's VCC/GND/OUT pins.
Power from 3.3 V on an ESP32 or Pico: every output has a 10 kOhm pull-up to VCC, so a 5 V supply would put 5 V on the GPIOs.
An output is LOW over white (its LED D1-D4 lights) and HIGH over a black line or with the probe lifted off the floor.
Mount the probes about 2-10 mm above the floor (TCRT5000 peak at 2.5 mm) and turn each trimmer so its LED is on over white and off over the line.
The four probe IR LEDs draw most of the current (roughly 100 mA at 5 V in total); power it from the board's 3V3 pin, not a GPIO.

example.code:
from line_tracker4 import LineTracker4
import time

tracker = LineTracker4({IN1}, {IN2}, {IN3}, {IN4})
while True:
    print('Line: %d %d %d %d' % tracker.line())
    time.sleep(0.3)

test.title: Reports probes 1 and 2 over white, 3 and 4 over the black line

library.note: Passed the Sparkbench part check in simulation and matched an independent datasheet reading. Not yet tested on real hardware.
